title: SRK on ‘King’: ‘Am I still a hero at 60, can I play my age?’
description: Shah Rukh Khan hosted a song launch event for his upcoming film 'King', where he discussed his age-related motivations. He expressed a desire to explore playing characters reflecting his actual age while still being a hero. Khan recalled amusing incidents that made him realize the significance of age difference with his co-stars. He aims to challenge himself in portraying a hero at 61 years old.

title: 'O.M Operation Mole' BO day 8

title: Nicole Scherzinger and Thom Evans call off engagement

Evans confirmed the separation, stating that the decision was made by Scherzinger herself. They initially met in 2019 on 'The X Factor' where Scherzinger was a judge. In June 2023, Evans proposed to Scherzinger, and she expressed hopes of starting a family. Previous relationships of Scherzinger include engagements and long-term connections with other notable figures.

Villeneuve emphasizes his commitment to the release date, despite the challenges posed by the Marvel franchise. He remains optimistic about the potential success of both films during this box office weekend.
